attempts.hypothesis: The measured body should have approximately constant instruction count across all benchmark calls; the nonempty indicator represents its executed path.

pcvs.name: nonempty
pcvs.rationale: Captures the branch selecting front access versus raising IndexError. All benchmark queues are nonempty, and both the length check and deque front access take constant work independent of queue size.

attempts.hypothesis: Peeking at the deque front has approximately constant instruction count across queue sizes; a fitted intercept with a near-zero size coefficient should explain the observations.

pcvs.name: queue_size
pcvs.rationale: Cheap entry-state cardinality supplies twelve distinct states, satisfying the measurement gate while allowing the fit to detect approximately constant cost.
